name: DCA Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier) Signature Cheddar Burger on Toasted Brioche & Malted Fries
brandOrRestaurant: Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Grilled custom-blend beef patty with melted aged cheddar on a super-soft toasted Amish brioche bun; ordering it plain without the roasted green chile and raw tomato makes it a great waterfront meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Cheddar Burger medium-well with aged cheddar and bacon only—specifically ask for **NO roasted green chile** and **NO chipotle-cherry barbecue sauce**.
watchOuts: Default build includes a roasted green chile pepper—always ask your server to leave the green chile off!
